{{Top|leg}}
'''Group One''' was the designation given to one of the task forces making up [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s armada in the years following the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral's]] breakaway from the Galactic Empire. It was composed of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Serpent's Smile]]'', the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Red Gauntlet]]'', the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Blood Gutter]]'' and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], Zsinj's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. Several other unspecified [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were also allocated to the group, which fought in a reduced size at the [[Battle of Vahaba]], where ''Serpent's Smile'' and ''Red Gauntlet'' were lost, and later at the [[Battle of Selaggis]].
